name: AI Related Content
description: Provides a Views Block integration with AI Search to surface related content by semantic (vector) similarity to the current node.

suggests.league/commonmark: Provides more representative text version of content to get better related content results.

project_description:
AI Related Content surfaces related/recommended content by semantic similarity using the AI Search submodule of the drupal/ai project. It ships three Search API Views plugins that attach to any AI-Search-backed index and a helper form that scaffolds a ready-to-use "AI Related Content" view (block display) from a bundled template.

The core piece is a Views filter plugin (AIRelatedContentNodeFilter, extending Search API's SearchApiFulltext) that, given the current node as a contextual argument, finds content most similar to it. It can either reuse an already-indexed embedding vector for that node (retrieved from a chosen vector-database index, average-pooled across chunks) or, in the default "always generate" mode, render the node in a chosen view mode and generate a fresh embedding on demand through the drupal/ai provider abstraction. It excludes the current node from its own results (nid NOT IN), and relies on Search API's own post-query per-result node access check so unpublished or access-restricted nodes never leak. A companion argument plugin (AIRelatedContentNodeArgument) loads and access-checks (node view) the source node, and a custom results-cache plugin (ai_related_content_results) stores only the entity id per cached row so raw embedding vectors are never serialized into the results cache.

Because vector search via an LLM has a per-call cost, the project emphasizes caching: the generated view uses time+tag caching keyed with node-grant and per-node cache contexts, and views_pre_render ties cached output to the source node's cache tags. Site builders select a view mode, a source-vector index (or on-demand generation), and an opt-in on-demand fallback per filter. The setup form at /admin/config/ai/ai-related-content-setup (permission: administer ai related content, restrict access) creates or resets the view for a chosen compatible index; hook_form_view_edit_form_alter surfaces misconfiguration warnings (missing indexed nid Filterable Attribute, missing contextual filter, source index without raw embedding vectors) on the Views edit page. Requires Views, Block, Search API, and AI Search 1.2+ with a configured Search API vector database.
